See Dallin H. Oaks, “Recovering from the Trap of Pornography,”Liahona,Oct. 2015, 52. President Oaks describes the distinction between different levels of involvement with pornography: “(1) inadvertent exposure, (2) occasional use, (3) intensive use, and (4) compulsive use (addiction).” It’s helpful to recognize that not everyone who uses pornography is “addicted.” There is hope for overcoming pornography, regardless of what level of involvement you’re at.
